name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
purpose: Expand access to clean cooking fuel.
benefit: Deposit-free LPG connection, first refill and stove, subject to the program terms.
documents: KYC, Aadhaar copies, household composition proof, address proof where applicable, bank proof and deprivation declaration.
rules: Household has no existing LPG connection
Household qualifies under the prescribed deprivation declaration

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
purpose: Provide income support to qualifying landholding farmer families.
benefit: ₹6,000 per year per qualifying family in three installments.
documents: Land records or locally accepted evidence, identity documentation and payment details as required by the authorities.
rules: No official exclusion applies to the family
Land records, ownership timing and regional exceptions confirmed by the authority

name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna (DTE)
purpose: Support qualifying students in eligible technical or professional courses.
benefit: Tuition and exam fee support as set out by MahaDBT for the applicable category and academic year.
documents: Marksheets, Maharashtra domicile certificate, family income certificate, CAP documents and applicable declarations.
rules: Applicant is enrolled as a student
Annual family income is ₹8 lakh or below
Remaining DTE conditions confirmed against MahaDBT (Indian nationality, EBC/EWS, CAP admission, eligible course and institution, other benefits, family limits and academic rules)
